ItemId.description: The enrollment id, a generated unique id. An enrollment with this id is updated.

UserName.description: The user name of the learner. A row whose user is not on the site is reported and skipped.

CourseId.description: The content item id of the course.

OfferingId.description: The course offering, when the course has offerings.

CreatedUtc.description: When the enrollment was created, in UTC.

StartedUtc.description: When the learner started, in UTC.

DueUtc.description: When the course is due, in UTC.

CompletedUtc.description: When the course was completed, in UTC.

ProgressPercent.description: The share of required items completed.

Grants.description: The reasons the learner has access: Source, SourceId, GrantedUtc, AccessEndsUtc.

History.description: The changes of state: From, To, ChangedUtc, Actor or ActorUserName, Reason.

Completion.description: The completion snapshot of a completed enrollment.

Progress.description: The progress on each course item: Items with ContentItemId, State, times, score and attestation.

Enrollments.description: The enrollments to create, or update by id, with their progress.

CourseId.description: The content item id of the course.

Hash.description: The salted hash of the enrollment key, as exported. The key itself is never exported.

CourseKeys.description: The enrollment keys of courses, as hashes.
